notes.title: Patch minor bugs with journal and certain puzzles
notes.notes: Opening the journal for the first time showed a picture. The journal was accessible during the puzzles on doors. Access to the journal has been removed during puzzle-solving.

notes.title: Version 1.1 is now Live!
notes.notes:

[/list]
